name: Media Asset Resolution
summary: Resolve a media request into a frozen local asset with cache reuse and a provenance-ledger record.
problem: Media searches can leave projects with unstable remote links, duplicate downloads and unclear asset provenance.
coreOutcomes: Check project and shared caches before acquiring media
Freeze the selected asset into a local project path
Record media metadata in the project ledger
requirements: A project directory and a specific image, icon, music or sound-effect need
The media-use scripts and any credentials required by an enabled provider
boundaries: Provider search and generation may be unavailable and must not be presented as successful when they fail
Verify usage rights before using acquired media in a public or commercial deliverable
